verdict.rationale: Metorial documents its own observability: teams can review traces, sessions, tool calls, auth events and failures, and the Agents area shows which clients connected and what they did. That covers per-event inspection of tool calls, users/agents and errors, but nothing shows aggregated usage analytics or any cost reporting. Missing for 10: aggregated call-volume metrics or dashboards, per-user usage rollups, error-rate analytics, cost tracking, analytics for published servers, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see usage analytics for the servers and tools my org consumes or publishes — call volumes, users, errors, and cost

citations.quote: Teams review traces, sessions, tool calls, auth events, and failures after work runs.
The Agents area shows which agent clients have connected to Workforce and what they have done.
with access controls and activity logs
